response.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
timing_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    eventannotm,
    AVG(instownpct) as timing_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
above_avg_timings AS (
  SELECT timing_avg
  FROM timing_avgs
  WHERE timing_avg > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(timing_avg) as mean_above_avg_ownership,
  AVG(timing_avg) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg) as avg_distance_above_overall
FROM above_avg_timings

assumptions.assumption: "How far above average they are on average" means the average of the differences (distances) from the overall average, equivalent to: mean_of_above_avg_timings − overall_average.
If no timings have average ownership strictly above the overall average, the query returns NULL (no qualifying groups).
